title: Tree attaining deterministic size
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. There exists a decision tree that computes $f$ and whose number of leaves equals the least number of leaves of any decision tree computing $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
